svg.title: Pressurized-water nuclear concept — Primary coolant and containment
svg.desc: Primary coolant and containment. 5 equipment references and 4 declared directed connections. Static illustrative symbols; arrows do not show instantaneous flow. This selected view does not include every plant connection.
svg.text: Primary coolant and containment · declared connections · illustrative equipment symbols
